Name: Medieval Perfumery
Author: lindest
Description:
A restyled building sprite for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36832]Perfumery[/url], with new animations on the water and furnace. Made to match "medieval" type craftables and buildings. 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral[/url] recolors will be auto-detected. You can configure the sprite with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. If you have have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url] installed, the building glows at night.

Options:
[list]
[*]Beige stone with warm toned concrete, or white brick with cool toned concrete
[*]Seasonal plants toggled on/off
[*]Light (with MMAP)
[*]Floating petal or leaf in the water on windy days
[/list]
Furnace is toggled in the base mod's config.
